root_cause_analysis.symptom: 13 systematic bugs surfaced during 2026-05-13 china-20260412-092624 review (renderer drops meal alts; name-string match brittle; optional-no-time silently dropped; renderer file too big to edit; BYPASS unwired; helper-path broken; --day flag no-op; no Cloudflare purge; trip_total stale; schema asymmetry; no cross-domain dedup; default-preserve-old-primary; no feature-status dashboard).
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: 13 distinct root causes — see per-bug measurement in evidence.measured field. Categorically: (a) renderer was built primary-only (Bug 1) with string-similarity name matching (Bug 2) and time-required filter (Bug 3); (b) hook gate documented BYPASS but never wired (Bug 5) and file accumulated to legacy size (Bug 4); (c) deploy chain has multiple hardcoded paths and shell-parser bug; (d) save path has no aggregate-recompute and no semantic linting; (e) docs lack milestone dashboard.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — pre-existing systematic state, not a single regressing commit. Closest commits: 1441e52 (spec-20260506-092951 root-cause hardening) touched adjacent territory but did not address these 13 bugs.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Iterative single-purpose implementations accumulated across multiple cycles; each was schema-correct at field level but the system lacked semantic-level invariants (cross-domain dedup, primary-replacement state, aggregate consistency).
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: User-visible content loss (Bug 1 drops alternatives), silent dropping (Bug 3), brittle name-matching (Bug 2), tooling friction (Bugs 4-5), broken deploy chain (Bugs 6-7), data drift (Bug 9), schema confusion (Bug 10), agent over-preservation (Bug 12).

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex identified: (1) save.py was double-routed Groups B+C — consolidate to single W5 save-semantics worker; (2) Group C and E both touched quality-gate.py — make gate-bypass a pre-step W1; (3) renderer-defensive alternatives[] reads at attractions/shopping/entertainment would entrench dual-shape schema dangerously — keep flat-list+optional shape only render visibly; (4) Bug 2 cannot be honestly fixed renderer-only — only gaode_id fast-path + name fallback, not entity-ID claim; (5) Bug 3 minimum-safe is render unscheduled optionals as cards, not invent times; (6) BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE fixes Bug 5 (doc mismatch) not Bug 4 (legacy debt) — Bug 4 stays deferred; (7) Bug 8 should be tracked in feature-status.md as N/A, not pure out-of-scope; (8) Bug 13 feature-status.md alone too hidden — link from README+index; (9) renderer verification requires live browser desktop+mobile.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: All 9 points incorporated: worker groups restructured to 6 file-disjoint workers with W1 sequential-first; W5 owns all save.py work; W1 owns gate file; Bug 10 explicitly forbids attractions/shopping/entertainment defensive reads in Non-Goals + W2 constraints; Bug 2 reframed as gaode_id fast-path only with explicit M2 deferral for full entity-ID; Bug 3 reframed as unscheduled-optionals cards (not invented times); Bug 4 explicitly deferred to M2 with feature-status tracking; Bug 8 reframed as N/A documentation in feature-status.md (still in cycle scope as doc-work); Bug 13 W6 adds README+index links; verification ACs (AC1, AC3) explicitly require screenshot evidence at desktop+mobile.
